text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I have finished offering
my New Year's prayers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There is only one goal I will set for this year—conquering the Tenno Sho (Spring).
choice_data_list: It's time to show what your hard work can do.
It's time to show what your hard work can do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. By spending time alongside Trainer,
I have definitely grown stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is to turn our hard work into results.
I shall show you a definitive victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer,
what shall we do once we return to the academy today?
choice_data_list: It's New Year's, so let's take it easy.
Just our usual training routine, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer,
what shall we do once we return to the academy today?
choice_data_list: It's New Year's, so let's take it easy.
Just our usual training routine, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
It is dangerous to rush ahead, swept away by impatience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I've set such an ambitious goal,
I must keep my own composure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A fresh start. Let us take it easy today
so we can spend the year with a calm and composed mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As usual... Yes,
that is indeed very important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Without getting pointlessly worked up,
to calmly carry out everyday tasks—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Because it is the beginning of a new year,
I must take care not to forget my original resolution.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, my, Trainer, you are completely floating on air, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, I am slightly curious as well—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem* I suppose I have no choice.
If it is Trainer's wish, I shall indulge you.
